visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a POV handheld shot focusing on a white plastic shopping bag resting on a light-colored wooden floor. A hand enters the frame and begins to peel back the plastic to reveal a large, grease-stained brown McDonald's paper bag inside. (2) The hand reaches into the brown bag and pulls it open further, revealing a massive red cardboard container filled to the brim with yellow French fries. The lighting is bright and indoor-focused. (3) The camera cuts to a medium shot of a woman with long brownish hair sitting cross-legged on the floor. She wears a grey sweatshirt and khaki skirt, holding a small plastic cup of chocolate sundae. She looks into the bag of fries with a look of genuine surprise and amusement, laughing. (4) The camera cuts again to a man sitting on the floor in front of a wardrobe. He is wearing a plain white t-shirt and light blue patterned pajama pants. He holds the large red carton of fries in both hands, gesturing with one hand toward it to emphasize its size. (5) The man brings the carton up to his face, demonstrating that the container is wider than his head. He gives a thumbs-up to the camera and proceeds to take a fry from the container and eat it with an satisfied expression.
